title: Surreal Cosmic Chart
description: An oval-framed mixed media artwork on graph paper features a large central triple-eyed face with a red third eye, surrounded by constellation lines, a purple planet with a red UFO, a black bow silhouette, and colorful wavy frequency lines labeled with terms like 'Desire', 'Fear', and 'Wisdom'. The bottom shows a screaming open-mouthed face with a colorful galaxy in its throat, a backpacker walking through a purple flower field, and various symbolic drawings.
prompt: Detailed surreal symbolic artwork on white graph paper with black oval frame, featuring a large central face with three eyes including a red third eye, colorful wavy lines labeled Desire Fear Wisdom, a purple planet with red UFO in the top right, black bow silhouette, screaming face at bottom with galaxy in its open mouth, a backpacker hiking through purple flower field, constellation lines, mystical symbols, hand-drawn mixed media style with colored markers and ink
